opportunities.title: Text recognition is offered by 2 of 3 major services
opportunities.detail: Some services already read printed text in this language, and an open OCR model covers it.
opportunities.why: About 177 million Arabic speakers are online and able to text today, and that should reach 210 million within five years. Ready to use: Tesseract OCR (covers this language); FineWeb-2 (33 billion words).

opportunities.title: 2 of 3 major voice assistants understand this language
opportunities.detail: One assistant already works in this language, so speech recognition, a voice and language understanding have been shown to be feasible.
opportunities.why: About 242 million Arabic speakers are online today, and that should reach 291 million within five years. Ready to use: YODAS2 (1,588 hours of transcribed speech); FLEURS (12 hours of transcribed speech).

note: Macrolanguage; vendors ship Modern Standard Arabic (arb) but LinguaMeta speaker counts sit on ar
